Speaking on Tuesday’s episode of The Grand Standoff: Iran and the World, Professor Mohammad Marandi discussed Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf’s remarks about achieving “sustainable deterrence." Professor Marandi said he understood this to mean developing military capabilities strong enough to ensure that no country would ever again consider attacking Iran. He added that Tehran was already moving in that direction. He pointed to the expansion of Iran’s missile and drone capabilities, saying new underground bases were being inaugurated, including two in the previous week. He also said a large number of officers from both the IRGC and the regular army had volunteered to join the missile and drone forces. Professor Marandi added that Iran’s missile and drone firepower had increased dramatically and would continue to grow to achieve this deterrence. Watch here: https://youtu.be/LtOgPN7BHEY

Trump laughed at Zelensky's deadline for peace deal During an interview, Trump reacted with laughter and disbelief when asked to comment on Zelensky's statement that US negotiators aim to finalize a Russia-Kiev peace deal by December-January. "Who said that? What does he want me to do?" Trump questioned, exchanging glances with an aide. The US leader clarified he has set no strict timeline for resolving the Ukrainian conflict. "I just want it finished," Trump stated. "I would like to achieve this one day, but it takes two to tango. We'll see what happens." @Slavyangrad
